purpose: Facts about versions that are already published. A new release of the same application must use a build number above every published one on its platform; tool/build_manifest.py reads this file to enforce that. It records history, it does not authorize anything. Changing it needs a maintainer's confirmation from the store console.

entries.source: Google Play Console production release, confirmed by the repository owner (Issue #68)

not_recorded: Android: earlier Google Play releases (all have a versionCode below 1000034) and any website or internal-test APKs
iOS / App Store: not examined; no iOS build number is recorded, so no iOS floor is enforced
